text:
ellie: Heads up — planning to push feature/fast-path to prod in today's 17:05 PT release slot. ETA ~20m. Includes kv-cache fix + small runtime tweak. Anyone object?
rajan: :thumbsup: infra ok, I'll own smoke and rollback ops. Can we start at 17:05 exactly?
ellie: 17:05 start works. We'll kick the canary first (5% for 10m) then ramp if green.
sam: Quick Q — there's a non-blocking online migration (add nullable col) that should go with this. Can we run migration during canary window?
ellie: yes, run migration in canary window. If migration errors show up, abort and rollback.
maya: I'll take post-canary checks: traces, 95p latency, and token-cost sanity. Ping me when canary finished.
rajan: I'll tail logs and check error rates. Command I'll run: `kubectl -n prod logs -l app=fast-path -f --since=1m`
ops-bot: Deploy job queued by release-train for 2026-03-18T17:05:00 PT — job id rt-1745-canary. Auto-notify enabled.
ellie: Deploy commands for reference:
```bash
./deploy --env=prod \\  --image=ghcr.io/redwood/fast-path:release-1745 \\  --canary=5 \\  --canary-duration=10m
```
rajan: Rollback plan: if canary error rate > 1% or latency spike > 50% -> `./deploy rollback --to-tag release-1744` and alert oncall. I'll keep the rollback command ready.
oncall: Oncall acked. Will monitor for 30m post-ramp and ready to assist with DB or routing rollback.
sam: I'll kick the migration with this SQL (safe add): `ALTER TABLE configs ADD COLUMN fast_path_enabled boolean DEFAULT false;` then flip during ramp.
ellie: Perfect. Summary: start 17:05 PT, canary 5% for 10m, migration during canary, maya smoke, rajan logs+rollback, oncall watching. If anything blocks, call abort. :rocket:
maya: Roger. I'll post back with quick checklist results within 12m of canary start.
rajan: Starting watchlist 5m prior. If no objections, I'll confirm "go" at 17:04 and trigger ops-bot.
ellie: No objections. Thanks all — will update thread with the deploy job id once launched.
